title: Traces of ancient blood found in 115 million-year-old dinosaur fossil, new study claims
caption:
Could we really be looking at 115-million-year-old blood cells? A new study found chemical signatures of heme in a Brazilian theropod fossil, though not every paleontologist is convinced by the evidence.

Source: Livescience - Traces of ancient blood found in 115 million-year-old dinosaur fossil, new study claims
